conf.description: AWS GovCloud CloudTrail management-events / eventbridge direct route: strip the EventBridge envelope, extract the ECS anchor fields, and restore the untouched inner CloudTrail record to _raw so it reaches the same logs-aws.cloudtrail data stream as the S3 feed, per recommendations.direct.cribl (detail kept as _raw audit-of-last-resort artifact, overriding the field table's aws.cloudtrail.flattened.detail custom target)

conf.comment: EventBridge delivers one CloudTrail management-event per message with the native record under detail{}. Per recommendations.direct.cribl this pipeline is a thin envelope-stripper: extract the envelope-only fields, pull the four ECS anchors CloudTrail's own record gives us, then snapshot the ORIGINAL untouched detail object into _raw before any rename mutates it, so the record stays byte-identical audit evidence and can still be reprocessed by whatever handles the S3-fed json record. cloud.account.id is deliberately taken from detail.recipientAccountId, never the envelope's account, per the field table's own note.

functions.description: Pipeline purpose, envelope-vs-record precedence, and _raw-snapshot ordering
Parse the EventBridge envelope (version/id/detail-type/source/account/time/region/resources/detail) from _raw JSON

Snapshot the pristine, unmutated CloudTrail record into _raw BEFORE the rename step below consumes any of detail's sub-fields - this is what recommendations.direct.cribl means by 'pass through with detail as _raw'

Computed fields read from ORIGINAL vendor names before rename: 'detail-type' has a hyphen so it needs bracket access (path-based rename/eval.add.name would 500), and sourceIPAddress gets the conditional IP-vs-AWS-service-DNS-name split the field notes call for (own conditional, since the S3-json feed's own regex is a separate work order not supplied here)

_time from the in-record API-completion time (detail.eventTime is a genuinely nested path here, not a flat dotted key, since serde just built real nested JSON) - never @timestamp (platform constraint). The envelope's own 'time' (bus-delivery time) is kept separately as event.created below, not used for _time.

Batch rename of the clean envelope fields and the clean nested detail.* ECS anchors. detail.recipientAccountId -> cloud.account.id is the authoritative account (per field notes); the envelope's own 'account' is intentionally NOT mapped to cloud.account.id (would silently collide/override on cross-account events) and carries no alternate custom target in the field table, so it is dropped below rather than invented a name for.

event.dataset (no hyphen) and cleanup: the envelope's cross-check-only 'account', the now-partially-mutated 'detail' object (superseded by the pristine _raw snapshot above), and the hyphenated 'detail-type' via glob (literal 'detail-type' is rejected by eval.remove)
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
